name: Auth Fly
description: Auth Fly is a self-hosted SSO Identity Provider for SAML 2.0 and OIDC, a hosted UI on UI8Kit, and adaptive SDKs that fit any language or framework. PoC is live with Hanko as the credential backend; MVP runs on Supabase or your own Postgres. No telemetry, no hidden update channels — security tracked in the open.
